Class StructureAssembly.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureAssembly.Builder
Enclosing class:
StructureAssembly
public static final class StructureAssembly.Builder extends Object
Adds named parts, repeats, and connections to an assembly recipe.

    • choice

      public StructureAssembly.Builder choice(String name, String ruleId, double probability, StructureAssembly present, StructureAssembly absent)
      Chooses between two groups each time this part appears. For example, include a branch with a chance of 0.3, or a cap otherwise.
      Parameters:
      name - the node name
      ruleId - the rule identifier for random sampling
      probability - the probability value (0.0 to 1.0)
      present - the fragment or group to include when selected
      absent - the replacement to include when not selected; may be empty
      Returns:
      this builder
